1.consolidated_definition: Dícese de cualquier persona o cosa muy vieja.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Ancient; said of any person or thing that is very old.

Alternatively:

Venerable; said of anything extremely aged.

Or:

Extremely aged; said of a person or object that has reached an advanced stage of age.
